messages.subject: Final week of registration for May introductory distance sampling workshop
parts:
If you are a procrastinator or slow 🐌to get around to things; your time has arrived 🛬.

The workshop will occur weekdays 05-16 May 2025. Registration deadline is Wednesday 23 April. The deadline cannot be extended.

If you are expecting to wait until the workshop comes around again 🎪, there is likely to be at most only one more offering of this workshop in 2025. There are no plans at present for an introductory workshop in 2026.

Complete workshop details and registration link can be found here:

https://distancesampling.org/training/announcements/intro-may-2025.html

If you have questions, I'd be happy to answer them.


Eric Rexstad

Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling

University of St Andrews
